d: Algorithms that put elements of a list in a certain order.

p: Merge Sort uses Divide and Conquer: split array in half, recursively sort, and merge back together (O(N log N) time, stable). Quick Sort uses a pivot to partition elements (O(N log N) expected, in-place, but unstable).
Merge Sort Merge Step: Use two pointers `i` and `j` to iterate through two sorted halves.
Compare halves, append smaller element to result array.

def merge(L, R):
  res = []
  i = j = 0
  while i < len(L) and j < len(R):
    if L[i] < R[j]:
      res.append(L[i]); i += 1
    else:
      res.append(R[j]); j += 1
  res.extend(L[i:])
  res.extend(R[j:])
  return res
Time: Merge O(N log N). Space: Merge O(N), Quick O(log N) call stack.
